brief: The canvas displays a cosmic environment composed of interconnected, nested crystal structures. These formations shimmer with glowing bioluminescent colors—deep blues, neon greens, and pulsing violets—appearing to crystallize and shift in three dimensions. The energy transfer begins with unseen solid forms, whose kinetic energy manifests as vibrant, flowing fluid dynamics that ripple through the crystalline matrix. A central, rhythmic pendulum drives the entire system, causing the crystals to continuously pulse and gently reconfigure themselves, giving the sense of life and deep, rhythmic mechanical resonance moving through the depths.
